topic: Machinery for land preparation in the Season Planner: operations, hire prices in Cameroon and the rule that suggests machines

clear.notes: Clearing 50,000 to 100,000 FCFA per ha in a tomato budget for Cameroon dated June 2026 (S1); midpoint used. The source does not say whether the work is done by machine or by hand.

plough.notes: Ploughing 80,000 to 150,000 FCFA per ha (S1); midpoint used.

ridge.label_en: Ridges or beds by tractor, hired
ridge.label_fr: Billons ou planches au tracteur, en location
ridge.notes: Ridging 100,000 to 200,000 FCFA per ha (S1); midpoint used.

price_check: A provider near Yaoundé charged 250,000 FCFA per ha for ploughing, harrowing and sowing on new sites and 230,000 on sites already served in September 2024, final price on quote (S2). Ploughing plus ridging at the midpoints above comes to 265,000 FCFA per ha. A West African rental guide gives 25,000 to 50,000 FCFA per ha for tractor ploughing (S3) and Kenyan private tractor owners charged 3,500 to 4,500 KES per acre in 2024, about 39,000 to 50,000 FCFA per ha (S4, S5): these lower prices are not used for Cameroon.
public_provider: CENEEMA, under the Ministry of Agriculture, presented 239 tractors of 90 HP and 118 heavy machines in March 2025, works through 12 regional branches and about 20 mechanisation pools, and sets each job after a site visit without a published tariff (S7, S8). The State announced a subsidy of 400 million FCFA for farm mechanisation in April 2026 (S9).
purchase_reference: Tractor of 60 HP 20,000 to 24,000 USD, 90 HP 26,000 to 37,000 USD, power tiller of 15 HP about 4,000 USD, and contract work about 52 USD per ha in Cameroon in 2013 (S6). Kept for a later version with owned machines.

hand_share.notes: Share of the hand work of a mechanised step that remains: levelling bed tops, corners and edges the tractor cannot reach. Djalumo Agro assumption to document in the 2027 pilot.

workers_per_day_max.notes: Above 15 workers needed on the same day for land preparation, the planner suggests hired machines: hiring and supervising more people for a short window is rarely realistic for a starting grower. Djalumo Agro assumption to check in the 2027 pilot.

plough.notes: The planting holes of this step are still dug by hand: half of the step is kept as hand work (assumption).

steps_notes: Planting holes, staking and work inside a greenhouse or a net house stay by hand.
not_included: Owning machines (purchase spread over its life, fuel, operator and maintenance) waits for dealer quotes in Cameroon. Heavy clearing of trees and stumps by bulldozer is quoted after a site visit and is not priced.
